purpose: Generated event projection with state/TECH, mandatory combat factors, platform-class capability review and novel/divergent weapon handling.
baseline_resolution: technical_baseline and branch overrides are read from the selected checkpoint, never hard-coded by the generator.
block_condition: UNKNOWN in a mandatory technical domain or semantic state requirement blocks final event computation unless a waiver is explicitly recorded downstream.
generation_rule: Select TECH entries by profile/tag/domain, apply runtime/date gates, expose checkpoint-local state bindings and maturation deltas, and never substitute opening state for later checkpoint state silently.
combat_rule: Final combat/gate adjudication requires combat factors and weapon/platform capability review to be ready. combat_resolution_ready is the combined readiness flag.
weapon_platform_rule: Mandatory platform classes are reviewed from the full current TECH baseline plus capability index even when normal event tags would omit them. Event-local novel/divergent systems require explicit capability/maturity/provenance.
